1.title: Tier 1 — Shared core (AI Engineer base)
1.blurb: Everything in this tier is assumed by Tiers 2 and 3. It is the AI Engineer baseline.

2.title: Tier 2 — AI Architect (adds)
2.blurb: The Architect owns the decisions and boundaries; Tier 1 is implemented by engineers under them.

3.title: Tier 3 — Forward Deployed Engineer (adds)
3.blurb: The FDE takes Tier 1 into a specific customer's systems, data, security posture and people.

llm-app.title: LLM-app AI Engineer
llm-app.desc: Tier 1 minus ML-fundamentals depth; distributed training and feature stores dropped.

fde.title: Forward Deployed Engineer
fde.desc: Tier 1 + Tier 3, with Tier 2 Reliability and Security as background reading.
